Overall Experience: Excellent overall. I was treated with great dignity and respect throughout my stay.
Staff Attitude: The nurses were incredibly kind and attentive. They checked on me regularly and always answered my questions.
Communication: I was kept fully informed about every stage of my treatment and what to expect next.
Environment: The ward was very clean and quiet at night which helped me rest and recover.
What Could Be Improved: Nothing I can think of. Everything was brilliant.

Overall Experience: Very positive experience. Felt safe and well cared for the entire time.
Staff Attitude: Staff were professional and compassionate. One nurse in particular went above and beyond to comfort me.
Communication: Doctors explained my diagnosis clearly and gave me time to ask questions.
Environment: The side room I was given was spotless. Temperature was comfortable.
What Could Be Improved: The food could be a bit warmer when served.

Overall Experience: Good experience overall despite the circumstances.
Staff Attitude: Most staff were friendly and helpful. Had a couple of rushed interactions but generally positive.
Communication: I was told about my medication changes but not always given reasons why.
Environment: Ward was clean but there were some noisy patients at night making sleep difficult.
What Could Be Improved: More information at discharge about what to watch out for at home would have helped.

Overall Experience: Satisfactory stay but some issues with waiting times.
Staff Attitude: Staff were mostly kind but seemed very stretched and busy.
Communication: Communication was inconsistent. Some doctors explained things well but others did not.
Environment: Clean environment but the toilets needed more frequent attention.
What Could Be Improved: Shorter waiting times before procedures and better staffing levels would improve things.

Overall Experience: Poor experience. Waited too long for pain relief and felt ignored at times.
Staff Attitude: Some staff were lovely but others seemed dismissive when I pressed my call button.
Communication: Nobody told me when my operation was scheduled. I found out from another patient.
Environment: Ward felt chaotic and I spotted some hygiene issues near the shared bathroom.
What Could Be Improved: Much better communication between staff and patients. Felt forgotten for hours.

Overall Experience: Extremely long waits made an already stressful situation worse.
Staff Attitude: A few staff members were warm and reassuring but many seemed too busy to talk.
Communication: I had to ask multiple times for updates on my test results. Very frustrating.
Environment: The ward was acceptable but the noise from the corridor made rest impossible.
What Could Be Improved: Faster response to call bells and more staff visible on the ward at night.

Overall Experience: Outstanding care from admission to discharge. Could not fault the team.
Staff Attitude: Every single member of staff treated me with kindness and professionalism.
Communication: My consultant took extra time to draw diagrams explaining my condition which really helped me understand.
Environment: Spotlessly clean ward. Fresh towels daily and bedding changed regularly.
What Could Be Improved: Honestly nothing. This was a very difficult time and the team made it bearable.

Overall Experience: Very good. Felt genuinely cared for not just processed.
Staff Attitude: Nurses were attentive and remembered personal details about me which made a real difference.
Communication: Ward rounds happened at consistent times and family were included in discussions when appropriate.
Environment: Clean and well organised. The food was actually surprisingly decent.
What Could Be Improved: Parking charges for long-stay patients and families are excessive and cause real stress.

Overall Experience: Reasonable experience but some gaps in care.
Staff Attitude: Staff were helpful when available but clearly understaffed on night shifts.
Communication: Received conflicting information from two different doctors about my discharge date.
Environment: Bathroom facilities were clean. The ward temperature was often too warm at night.
What Could Be Improved: Consistency of information from the care team and better overnight staffing would help greatly.

Overall Experience: Not a pleasant experience. Felt like a burden rather than a patient.
Staff Attitude: Night staff were dismissive and slow to respond. Day staff were much better.
Communication: I was told my operation would be at nine in the morning. It was eventually done at five in the afternoon with no explanation.
Environment: The ward smelled of disinfectant but I did notice some equipment that looked unclean.
What Could Be Improved: Better communication when delays happen and treating patients as individuals not numbers.

Overall Experience: My pain was not managed well and this was the biggest issue.
Staff Attitude: Staff acknowledged my concerns but seemed powerless to act. System issues not individual failures.
Communication: Pain management plan was discussed once then never reviewed despite my repeated requests for stronger medication.
Environment: Environment was fine and well maintained.
What Could Be Improved: A proper pain review process where patients can flag uncontrolled pain and get a timely clinical response.

Overall Experience: Tremendous experience. Staff went above and beyond every single day.
Staff Attitude: All staff from porters to consultants were warm and genuinely caring.
Communication: I was told what was happening at every step and never felt confused or anxious about the process.
Environment: The ward was immaculate and there was a quiet area where I could speak to family in private.
What Could Be Improved: Perhaps more volunteers or companion visits for patients who do not have family nearby.

Overall Experience: Good overall but the discharge process was rushed and stressful.
Staff Attitude: Wonderful nursing staff. Felt like they really knew me as a person.
Communication: Good communication during my stay but discharge information was vague and rushed.
Environment: Acceptable environment. Had one issue with a broken call bell that took two days to fix.
What Could Be Improved: A proper discharge checklist explained verbally would make a big difference for patients going home alone.

Overall Experience: Mixed experience. Great surgery team but poor ward aftercare.
Staff Attitude: Theatre staff were exceptional and reassuring. Ward staff seemed overworked and sometimes curt.
Communication: The surgical team communicated brilliantly. After surgery wound care instructions were unclear.
Environment: Operating area was pristine. The ward was clean but noisy during the day.
What Could Be Improved: A structured handover between theatre teams and ward nurses so nothing falls through the gaps.

Overall Experience: Very poor. Discharge was arranged without my carer being informed or involved.
Staff Attitude: Most staff were kind but there were communication failures that caused real problems for me.
Communication: I repeatedly asked for my family to be contacted before discharge. This did not happen until I was already in a taxi.
Environment: Clean ward but the bed nearest the window had a faulty curtain giving no privacy.
What Could Be Improved: Mandatory involvement of carers and family in discharge planning for patients who need support at home.

Overall Experience: Excellent experience throughout a frightening time.
Staff Attitude: The palliative care nurses were extraordinary. Compassionate and always present when needed.
Communication: Family meetings were held regularly and we were always told the truth gently and with care.
Environment: A calm and private environment which meant a lot during such a difficult time.
What Could Be Improved: More visible information about what support is available to families after bereavement.

Overall Experience: Positive but a few issues with information given at admission.
Staff Attitude: Staff were busy but always stopped to help when asked and never made me feel like a nuisance.
Communication: Initial information at admission was confusing. Once I had a named nurse things improved significantly.
Environment: The ward was clean and reasonably quiet. Meals were adequate.
What Could Be Improved: Named nurse system made a real difference. This should be standard and better communicated at the start.

Overall Experience: My mental health needs were largely ignored during my physical admission.
Staff Attitude: Physical health staff were caring but lacked training or confidence around mental health.
Communication: Nobody asked about my mental health even though it was clearly affecting my recovery.
Environment: Environment was fine for physical care but not adapted for patients with anxiety or sensory sensitivities.
What Could Be Improved: Mental health screening at admission and access to a liaison psychiatry nurse would have helped enormously.

Overall Experience: Wonderful staff but the food was consistently poor and this affected my recovery.
Staff Attitude: I cannot praise the nursing staff highly enough. Patient kind and tireless.
Communication: All information was clear and my family were kept updated at every stage.
Environment: Clean ward and comfortable bed. The food however was cold and nutritionally poor.
What Could Be Improved: A proper review of the food service. Nutrition really matters when you are trying to heal.

Overall Experience: Reasonably good experience. Main complaint is about parking and access.
Staff Attitude: Staff were professional and attentive throughout my stay.
Communication: Good clinical communication throughout. Letters after discharge were prompt and easy to understand.
Environment: Clean and well maintained. Good access to natural light which helped my mood during recovery.
What Could Be Improved: Parking is a genuine barrier for patients and families. Some form of subsidy for those attending frequently.

Overall Experience: The lack of continuity with doctors was my biggest frustration.
Staff Attitude: Nursing staff were consistent and excellent. Different doctor every day was confusing.
Communication: Difficult to build a relationship with the clinical team when the consultant changed every day.
Environment: Clean ward. Temperature was fine. Found the communal bathroom areas adequate.
What Could Be Improved: A named consultant or better handover notes so patients do not have to re-explain their situation each day.

Overall Experience: I felt safe and respected throughout a lengthy admission.
Staff Attitude: Every member of staff I met was professional and warm. Special mention to the physiotherapy team.
Communication: I was given detailed written information about my condition and a clear plan for rehabilitation.
Environment: The rehabilitation ward was bright and clean with good facilities for exercise and movement.
What Could Be Improved: Possibly more psychological support for patients facing long-term disability after illness.

Overall Experience: Chaotic admission process but good care once settled on the ward.
Staff Attitude: Admissions staff were harassed and communication suffered. Ward staff were brilliant.
Communication: Initial information was chaotic and stressful. Once on the ward everything was clearly explained.
Environment: Clean ward. Shared bay was a bit noisy but staff managed this well.
What Could Be Improved: A smoother admissions pathway and better communication between the emergency department and wards.

Overall Experience: Excellent end of life care for my mother. Cannot thank the team enough.
Staff Attitude: Nurses were compassionate beyond measure. They supported the whole family not just my mother.
Communication: The team were honest about prognosis and gave us time to ask questions and say goodbye.
Environment: A peaceful private room was provided which meant everything to us as a family.
What Could Be Improved: Nothing. This was the best possible experience in the worst possible circumstances.

Overall Experience: Good experience but had concerns about infection control.
Staff Attitude: Staff were friendly and professional throughout my stay.
Communication: Good communication about my treatment. However I was not told about the infection risk in shared bays.
Environment: Ward was generally clean but observed some poor hand hygiene from visitors and occasionally staff.
What Could Be Improved: Stricter enforcement of hand hygiene protocols especially for visitors and better information for patients.

Overall Experience: Positive experience overall. Staff clearly work incredibly hard.
Staff Attitude: Staff were attentive and cheerful despite what appeared to be an extremely pressured environment.
Communication: Good communication. My GP was also kept informed which meant a smooth transition home.
Environment: Clean environment. The ward felt calm and well organised even during busy periods.
What Could Be Improved: More visible acknowledgment and support for staff. They are clearly under enormous pressure.

Overall Experience: I found the whole experience deeply distressing due to poor communication.
Staff Attitude: Some staff were excellent but there was clearly no system for sharing information between shifts.
Communication: Nobody told me about a change in my treatment plan. I found out from reading my own notes.
Environment: The ward was clean. I had no complaints about the physical environment.
What Could Be Improved: A proper handover system and a daily summary for patients about their own care and plan.

Overall Experience: Very positive. The children's ward team was exceptional.
Staff Attitude: Staff were warm and made my daughter feel safe and comfortable.
Communication: Parents were included in all decisions and given written summaries of each day's plan.
Environment: Bright and child-friendly environment. Clean and well organised.
What Could Be Improved: Perhaps a dedicated quiet room for parents who need to step away briefly without leaving the ward.

Overall Experience: Adequate care but felt like a number in a system rather than a person.
Staff Attitude: Staff were competent but interactions often felt rushed and transactional.
Communication: I received information but it was delivered quickly and I did not feel I had time to ask questions.
Environment: Clean and functional environment. Nothing remarkable positive or negative.
What Could Be Improved: Time for staff to sit and talk with patients even briefly. Human connection matters enormously.

Overall Experience: Overall a positive experience with one significant issue around consent.
Staff Attitude: Fantastic nursing team. Felt genuinely cared for throughout.
Communication: I was not given adequate information before consenting to a procedure. Felt pressured to agree quickly.
Environment: Clean and comfortable environment throughout my stay.
What Could Be Improved: A robust consent process with dedicated time for patients to ask questions and a cooling off period where appropriate.
